title: TRACER: Trace-Regularized Training Against Indirect Prompt Injection
abstract: arXiv:2610.19133v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Indirect prompt injection uses untrusted retrieved content, tool outputs, or agent messages to override an LLM's intended behavior. We show that defense robustness is channel-conditioned: the same attack succeeds 18% of the time as a follow-up message but 53% when placed in retrieved context. We propose TRACER (Trace-Regularized Adversarial Channel Exposure with Reward-shaping), a channel-aware adversarial training method that samples presentation wrappers and combines an answer-anchored, evidence-gated reward with ATRC, which aligns attacked reasoning with clean evidence when an injection is invalid. On GSM8K with Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, TRACER reduces RAG-framed ASR from 65.5% to 6.1% while preserving 78-82% clean accuracy. Joint RAG+tool training achieves 13.9% average ASR across framings at 3B scale, while a single epoch at 7B reaches 9.4%. These results demonstrate that robust defenses must explicitly train and evaluate across deployme

translated_title: TRACER：面向间接提示注入的轨迹正则化训练
translated_abstract: 间接提示注入利用不可信的检索内容、工具输出或智能体消息来覆盖大语言模型的预期行为。我们证明了防御的鲁棒性依赖于通道条件：同一攻击作为后续消息时成功率为18%，但放在检索上下文中时成功率为53%。我们提出了TRACER（带奖励塑形的轨迹正则化对抗通道暴露），这是一种通道感知的对抗训练方法，它通过采样呈现包装形式，并将以答案为锚点、以证据为门控的奖励与ATRC相结合，在注入无效时将被攻击的推理与干净证据对齐。在GSM8K上使用Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct，TRACER将RAG框架下的攻击成功率（ASR）从65.5%降低到6.1%，同时保持78-82%的干净准确率。在3B规模上，RAG+工具的联合训练在各类框架下实现13.9%的平均攻击成功率，而7B模型仅需单个epoch即可达到9.4%。这些结果表明，鲁棒的防御必须在不同的部署通道上进行显式的训练和评估。
tldr: TRACER提出了一种通道感知的对抗训练方法，通过轨迹正则化与奖励塑形，将RAG场景下的间接提示注入攻击成功率从65.5%大幅降至6.1%，同时保持模型的干净任务准确率。
